topics.title: Sources of information about the interior
topics.ncert_sections: Sources of information about the interior: direct and indirect sources

concepts.learning_objective: Identify mining, deep drilling and volcanic eruptions as direct sources of information about the earth's interior.
Explain how temperature, pressure, density, meteors, gravitation and magnetism give indirect evidence of the interior.
Interpret gravity anomalies as evidence of the distribution of mass in the crust.

topics.title: Earthquakes and earthquake waves
topics.ncert_sections: Earthquake; Why does the earth shake?; Earthquake waves; Propagation of earthquake waves

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how energy released along a fault produces an earthquake and define focus and epicentre.
Distinguish P-waves, S-waves and surface waves by speed, medium and destructiveness.
Explain how P-waves and S-waves vibrate relative to the direction of propagation.
Locate the shadow zones of P-waves and S-waves in terms of angular distance from the epicentre.
Infer the liquid nature of the outer core from the absence of S-waves beyond 105 degrees.

topics.title: Types, measurement and effects of earthquakes
topics.ncert_sections: Types of earthquakes; Measuring earthquakes; Effects of earthquake; Frequency of earthquake occurrences

concepts.learning_objective: Classify earthquakes as tectonic, volcanic, collapse, explosion and reservoir induced.
Distinguish the Richter magnitude scale from the Mercalli intensity scale.
Identify the hazardous effects of earthquakes and the conditions for a tsunami.

topics.title: Structure of the earth
topics.ncert_sections: Structure of the earth: the crust, the mantle, the core

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the thickness and nature of the oceanic and continental crust.
Describe the extent of the mantle, the asthenosphere and the lithosphere.
Describe the state and composition of the outer and inner core.

topics.title: Volcanoes
topics.ncert_sections: Volcanoes and volcanic landforms; Volcanoes (shield, composite, caldera, flood basalt, mid-ocean ridge)

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish magma from lava and name the materials a volcano releases.
Compare shield, composite, caldera, flood basalt and mid-ocean ridge volcanoes.

topics.title: Intrusive volcanic landforms
topics.ncert_sections: Volcanic landforms: intrusive forms (batholiths, lacoliths, lapolith, phacolith, sills, dykes)

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish volcanic rocks from plutonic rocks by where the lava cools.
Identify batholiths, lacoliths, lapoliths, phacoliths, sills, sheets and dykes from their shape and position.
